_note: Configuration presets consumed by scripts/auto-populate-configuration.py. Each preset declares the parameters of the floor + cost-ceiling + cost-sort algorithm. Floor values are percentages of the top intelligence score within a bucket. Cost ceilings are $/M blended tokens. Budget derives an adaptive ceiling from the current high-end normal price while trimming obvious price outliers; Speed gates by latency, then takes the best-value knee of the cost/intelligence Pareto frontier over the same paid-model path (no floor or ceiling). The 'mode' field switches the algorithm path: 'paid_intelligence' (Premium/Budget/Speed) operates over paid models; 'free_intelligence' operates over the free models list with no cost math.

premium.description: Highest-ranking models available; cost ignored. Best-of-bucket per slot.

budget.description: Cheapest models that pass a moving quality floor and adaptive price ceiling. Most users land here.

adaptive_cost_ceiling._note: Start Budget at 30% of the current high-end normal price. The peak ignores prices above 3x the median of floor-qualified candidates so GPT-Pro/o1-style outliers do not anchor value picks.

free.description: Free-tier models only. Intelligence-descending. Free Models Router included as the first option when available.

speed.description: Fastest first response, best value within the speed budget. Each slot is gated to models whose time-to-first-token is within a latency ceiling (the speed promise), then takes the best-value KNEE of the cost/intelligence Pareto frontier inside that gate — the diminishing-returns point that captures cheaply-available intelligence and dodges cost cliffs (e.g. a 15x-pricier model for a few more intelligence points). Reasoning models excluded everywhere (they stall before the first token). Latency from OpenRouter per-provider stats (or_ttft_ms), AA median (latency_ttft_seconds) as fallback.
speed._note: PROVISIONAL + retunable (no empirical calibration yet): latency_ceiling_ms 1200 is the speed promise (the TTFT budget); knee_cost_normalization 'log' captures cheaply-available intelligence and only declines at true cost cliffs — set 'linear' to lean cheaper (penalizes absolute dollars more). The knee = argmax(normalized intelligence - normalized cost) on the latency-gated cost/intelligence Pareto frontier, tiebreak smarter -> cheaper -> newer; primary = knee, fallbacks = next-best-value frontier neighbours then fastest. There is NO intelligence floor or cost ceiling — the knee replaces both (user decision 2026-06-30; Budget remains the cost-minimizer). Applied UNIFORMLY to every slot by populate_configuration's knee path. Retune once Speed bakes can be observed against real registry latency.

utility._note: top_n=3 feeds the popout's three-row small section (1 primary + 2 fallbacks).

analysis.gear4._note: When diversity is enforced for the workhorse pair, breadth picks exclude depth's primary so the second slot reaches for a different model family. top_n=4 feeds the popout's four-row large section (1 primary + 3 fallbacks per chain).

analysis.gear3._note: Retained for backward compatibility. The Fast slot owns gear3.depth + gear3.breadth in the new schema (2026-05-23) — populate_configuration skips this block when slot_specs.fast is present.

fast._note: Mid-tier speed-optimized slot. Primary → gear3.depth + utility.gear2_rag_lookup; secondary → gear3.breadth when adversarial diversity is on (mirrored from primary via post-bake when off). Fast is vision_required so the visual pane always has a fast vision model available even when the global Vision-only toggle is off. No size_bucket gate. min_tokens_per_second=80 is a hard floor, and models with no throughput data do not pass. After that speed gate, each preset optimizes normally: Premium by intelligence, Budget by its value/cost rule, Speed by its latency-gated knee. With no slot-level floor_pct, the Fast slot inherits each preset's own rule: Premium uses floor_pct_if_intelligence_first=80, Budget 70 (min 50), Free none; Speed applies its latency-gated knee here like every other slot (no floor). floor_pct_if_intelligence_first=80 for Premium keeps its fast slot high-intelligence among fast-enough models. top_n=4 → 1 primary + 3 fallbacks per chain, mirror of analysis.gear4.

vision_substitute._note: Vision substitute picks come from the large bucket filtered to vision_capable=True. Threaded into every cell's vision_substitute field.
